name: Jugendzeltplatz Rettenau
beschreibung: The Rettenau Youth Tent Campground is located in the municipality of Niederndorferberg in the Tiroler Kaiserwinkl. The surroundings are characterized by the Chiemgauer Alpen and the Kaisergebirge. From here, several marked hiking trails are accessible. In winter, the nearby ski areas Kössen and Walchsee are available. The campground's facilities include simple sanitary facilities and areas for pitching tents. It is primarily aimed at youth groups and budget-conscious individual travelers. The atmosphere on the grounds is quiet and close to nature. Guests can expect simple accommodation in close proximity to the Tiroler alpine world.
